<p>
	At the time of inspection, the business had recently undergone a change of ownership and the premises were still in the process of being set up and brought to our operational standards.&nbsp; Some areas were not yet fully organised as we were completing necessary repairs, cleaning, and system implementations.&nbsp; These conditions were temporary and not reflective of our usual standards.&nbsp; Since the inspection, all outstanding works have been completed and appropriate procedures are now in place to ensure full compliance is maintained.</p>
